mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO boarding_prediction_snapshot ( calculation_id, journey_id, location_observation_id, vehicle_run_observation_id, arrival_prediction_observation_id, provider_vehicle_id, pace_type, pace_speed_mps, distance_m, user_expected_at, user_min_expected_at, user_max_expected_at, vehicle_expected_at, vehicle_min_expected_at, vehicle_max_expected_at, boarding_probability, decision, recommended, confidence, model_version, factors, calculated_at, expires_at ) VALUES
( #{snapshot.calculationId}, #{snapshot.journeyId}, #{snapshot.locationObservationId}, #{snapshot.vehicleRunObservationId}, #{snapshot.arrivalPredictionObservationId}, #{snapshot.providerVehicleId}, #{snapshot.paceType}, #{snapshot.paceSpeedMps}, #{snapshot.distanceM}, #{snapshot.userExpectedAt}, #{snapshot.userMinExpectedAt}, #{snapshot.userMaxExpectedAt}, #{snapshot.vehicleExpectedAt}, #{snapshot.vehicleMinExpectedAt}, #{snapshot.vehicleMaxExpectedAt}, #{snapshot.boardingProbability}, #{snapshot.decision}, #{snapshot.recommended}, #{snapshot.confidence}, #{snapshot.modelVersion}, CAST(#{snapshot.factorsJson} AS JSONB), #{snapshot.calculatedAt}, #{snapshot.expiresAt} )
mapper.select: SELECT FROM boarding_prediction_snapshot WHERE journey_id = #{journeyId} AND expires_at >= #{asOf} AND calculation_id = ( SELECT calculation_id FROM boarding_prediction_snapshot WHERE journey_id = #{journeyId} AND expires_at >= #{asOf} ORDER BY calculated_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT 1 ) ORDER BY provider_vehicle_id, CASE pace_type WHEN 'SLOW_WALK' THEN 1 WHEN 'WALK' THEN 2 WHEN 'FAST_WALK' THEN 3 WHEN 'RUN' THEN 4 ELSE 5 END
